tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports a gradient-dependent sink and a coupled memory lag, but has only five endpoints for five parameters, all at H = 0.38–0.52. The trajectory batch adds time-resolved observations to distinguish the fast memory timescale from coupling strength before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled RK4 model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations at similar horizons could fit the pilot without reliably separating the fast memory timescale from the coupling strength.
It is not offered, and the pilot already spans a broad gradient range without detected collinearity.
It does not constrain the coupled transient dynamics.
